rationale: Refined volatility-gated momentum using inverse volatility weighting: short-term return (5-day) is weighted by a function that gives higher weight to low-volatility periods. Volatility is measured as the 20-day rolling standard deviation of daily returns. The weight is 1.5 - 0.5 * time-series rank of volatility percentile, so low volatility receives weight near 1.0 and high volatility near 0.5.
